seal: derivflow rate question — crystallization transition scale, shape, and seed-class dependence
scope_ref: TRACK0_SCOPE.md v1.4 §7 (question), §4 (k-parameterization + interlacing floor), §6.iv (a/b split), §9 (literature status incl. 2026-08-11 adversarial pull)
preamble_ordering: This seal is written BEFORE the §6.iv-b realization ensemble runs. Reason, stated as the seal's own justification: -b replicates are same-pipeline transition data, so the only ordering under which the error-bar ensemble contributes zero pre-seal information is seal-first. Consequence: the fitted iid data will be entirely post-seal (the -b ensemble mean), and the disclosed pre-seal iid curve (RNG seed 0) is NOT consumed by any fit.

disclosure_ledger.note: 'Seen' and 'fitted' are different slots; both sides are named. A referee who finds the pre-seal artifacts in history and no disclosure here has found a real problem; disclosed, they are Track-0 doing its job.
seen_pre_seal: iid transition LOCATION at n=4096: k in ~1..32 (1-<rtilde> falls 0.329 at k=1 to 5.8e-4 at k=32; ceiling ~1.4e-4 by k=64). Source: track0_jitter_floor.json unperturbed column — a 7-point k-curve (k in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64}); Will's message said '19-point'; 19 was the flow count, 7 is the point count — corrected here per filing discipline.
iid coarse shape, 2 points at n=256 (smoke): 1-<rtilde> 0.275 (k=1), 0.029 (k=4).
iid at-ceiling plateau for s >= 0.1 at n in {1024,2048,4096} (track0_iid_scaling.json): 1-<rtilde> ~ 1e-5..1e-7, sigma2(8) 0.00-0.04.
Hermite ceiling arm at n=512 across all s (track0_hermite_gate.json): 1-<rtilde> 2.4e-7..4.2e-5.
KS n-scaling slopes ~ -1 (rigidity witness), pop-vs-emp reference gap, jitter floor and transfer ratios (all Track-0 artifacts).
blind_at_sealing: Every fit and every functional-form selection (no form has been fit to anything).
The GUE seed's transition curve, entirely (never generated).
The picket-fence seed's flow behavior, entirely (never flowed).
The -b ensemble (not yet run) and therefore every sigma the fits will consume.
The cross-seed universality comparison — the sealed question itself.
disclosure_ledger.predictive_content: Form (blind), rate parameters (blind), cross-seed agreement (blind). Transition LOCATION is explicitly EXCLUDED from what this seal claims to predict for the iid seed (disclosed above as known); location remains a genuine prediction for the GUE and picket-fence seeds.

question: Bracketed by the program-derived interlacing floor at k = O(1) (unchallenged and unduplicated per the 2026-08-11 pull; rests on deterministic Rolle interlacing plus this program's computation) and the measured Hermite ceiling at k = n/10: at what scale and with what shape does local crystallization complete along the derivative flow, and are the selected form and its shape parameters seed-class-independent?

design.k_grid_doc_note: documentation rows at n=4096 only, base curves, outside all fits; marked ceiling

readouts.primary: log10(1 - <rtilde>) on the bulk window (BULK_FRACTION 0.20, inherited Phase 1/3 convention), per k
readouts.secondary_consistency_witness: Sigma2(L=8) slope per k — consistency check only, never a second chance at the verdict

design.fit_window_rule: per (seed, n): k-points with ensemble-mean 1 - <rtilde> > 1e-3 enter the fit (rule fixed here; consistent with 6.iv-a FLOOR_SIGNAL_MIN); remaining rows marked ceiling

functional_form_ladder.fit_space: log10(1 - <rtilde>) of the ensemble MEAN per k, weighted by sigma_mean propagated from the -b ensemble (delta method)
functional_form_ladder.selection: AICc on the fit-window points, per (seed, n); parameter counts 2/2/3
functional_form_ladder.preregistration_ordering: ladder filed in scope v1.4 commit 87437a7, before any k-resolved transition data existed

sigma_source.instrument: 6.iv-b realization ensemble — NOT a gate; the only sigma the fits and verdict consume
sigma_source.replicates_note: pinned at 16, not '8-16' — a range resolved after seeing spread would be a choice; 16 gives the sigma estimate honest degrees of freedom and is cheap at small k
sigma_source.per_k_sigma: sample std across the 16 replicates; sigma_mean = std/sqrt(16)

seeds.iid: Uniform[-1,1], n iid draws, sorted. The fitted iid data is the -b ensemble (16 fresh draws per n); the pre-seal RNG-seed-0 curve is disclosed, not consumed.
seeds.gue: Dumitriu-Edelman Hermite beta=2 tridiagonal (same generator family as arsrh/phase1_zeta_crossover.py's GUE arm): diagonal N(0,2), off-diagonal chi_{2(n-i)}, matrix divided by sqrt(2); FULL spectrum via eigvalsh_tridiagonal (not a central window — the seed is the whole point set); eigenvalues rescaled by 1/sqrt(n); 16 replicates per n.
seeds.picket_fence: deterministic: x_j = -1 + 2j/(n-1), j = 0..n-1; single run per n (no ensemble; no randomness)
seeds.hermite_ceiling: roots of H_n; the measured finite-n ceiling arm (order-of-limits per scope §9); not a fitted seed

rng_protocol.derivation: numpy SeedSequence(20260811).spawn(96); children 0-47 = iid replicates (16 per n, n ascending); children 48-95 = GUE replicates (16 per n, n ascending)
rng_protocol.property: ensemble enumerable in advance; replicate selection impossible by construction

adjudication.universality_primary: at n = 4096: iid vs GUE. If AICc selects DIFFERENT forms for the two seeds: RATE-SEED-DEPENDENT (form disagreement is itself the verdict). If the same form: compare SHAPE parameters only (b for F1; tau for F2; tau and beta for F3) — amplitude a is excluded (seed-dependent prefactor allowed). z = |theta_iid - theta_gue| / sqrt(var_iid + var_gue) with variances from the weighted-fit covariance. ALL shape parameters z < 3: RATE-UNIVERSAL. ANY z >= 5: RATE-SEED-DEPENDENT. Otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE, which MUST carry the power statement (the parameter separation that WOULD have been resolvable at the achieved sigma) or be declared a clean FAIL of the design.
adjudication.scale_secondary: descriptive, no forced verdict: k*(n) = fitted-curve crossing of 1 - <rtilde> = 1e-2, reported per seed with CI at n in {1024, 2048, 4096}; the k*(n) trend (log n vs n^alpha) is reported as a table with the honest statement that 3 n-points bound but do not select the scale law
adjudication.picket_fence_clause: starts crystalline, so the form ladder is inapplicable by construction; adjudicated on its own pre-registered prediction: 1 - <rtilde> < 1e-3 at every fit-grid k and every n (ceiling invariance under the flow). Holds: CEILING-INVARIANT witness banked, excluded from the form comparison. Fails: that is a FINDING (the flow moved a crystal off ceiling), filed separately, and it does NOT enter the universality verdict.
adjudication.escalation_note: the §6.iii gate passed through the STRICT branch; the pre-committed escalation rule exists in scope v1.3 but was never exercised and this seal does not rest on it

bindings.adjudicates_under: track0_harness.py, free_conv.py, track0_iid_scaling.py (reference_cdf), track0_jitter_floor.py as of that commit
bindings.post_seal_change_protocol: any post-seal change to flow solver, evaluator, unfolding, or readout code triggers re-run of the affected gates BEFORE any science curve is computed under the new code. Precedent, cited as the protocol working: the 25+5 solver speedup (commit 286420d) triggered Hermite gate re-certification against the 655700f baseline and re-passed bit-identical before §6.iii consumed the new solver.
